## 2f889ed81450

**Reproduced teaching/domain restriction: ordinary generation never demonstrates
boundary clipping.** Generator SHA-256 is
`2d616c5f9f1780fff1ddc8766cce179d3db71f274d90dd88b79e3c78dfd49e06`;
executed canonical rule hash is `c0f655f59db5` (rule-text SHA-256
`a10be34e297fdb698d70190c098845cc36e1d29f8a3001fbd7837ddbaad35ed4`).

For seed `20261007`, medium difficulty, sample indices `0..62`, all 63 generated
inputs passed `self_check`, every seed had border margin at least two, and the rival
“expand a seed only when all four distance-2 destinations are in bounds” matched all
63 Racket outputs. The same rival fails canonical train example 0, where a seed at row
1 must still paint its in-bounds left, right, and downward rays. That canonical witness
passes the current `self_check` but is outside the documented default generator domain.
See `checks/audit/2f889ed81450/counterexample.json`, with the complete Racket batch in
`checks/audit/2f889ed81450/racket.json` and rival outputs beside it.

This is a reproduced coverage defect, not a claim that an ordinary generated grid is
mislabeled. Suggested repair (not applied): include lawful near-edge seeds in normal
profiles, declare an `interior_seeds_only` rival, and strengthen `self_check` to match
the stated domain. The lint stage also fails because `RULE_HASH` is missing; see
`checks/audit/2f889ed81450-lint/checks/2f889ed81450_before_lint.log`. No audit-target
source was changed.

## 2f889ed81450

**Conclusion: reproduced defect.** Audited source SHA:
`2d616c5f9f1780fff1ddc8766cce179d3db71f274d90dd88b79e3c78dfd49e06`.
No source was changed.

The strongest observed teaching shortcut is **interior seeds only**: expand a
seed to the four same-color cells at Manhattan distance two only when all four
destinations remain inside the grid; otherwise leave that seed unchanged. On 60
ordinary medium draws from seed `20261019`, sample indices `0..59`, every input
passed `self_check`, every nonzero seed had minimum border margin at least 2, and
the rival matched the authoritative Racket output **60/60**.

Canonical train pair 0 is an exact counterexample. It passes the target’s
`self_check`, has minimum border margin 1, and authoritative rule hash
`c0f655f59db5` expands the near-edge color-4 seed with boundary clipping. The
interior-only rival leaves that seed unchanged, so its output disagrees. Exact
input, authoritative output, rival output, hashes, and commands are in
`checks/audit/2f889ed81450/counterexample.json`; the supported Racket receipt is
`checks/audit/2f889ed81450/racket.json`.

Two contract defects accompany the shortcut:

1. `self_check` accepts a hand-built pair of seeds at Manhattan distance 2 even
   though the documented invariant says no two cells are within distance 4.
2. `generate(seed=20261019, sample_index=0, difficulty="medium",
   n_seeds=1, n_distinct_colors=1)` returns two seeds and two nonzero colors while
   passing `self_check`.

The strict audit lint stage failed: missing required `RULE_HASH` plus two
unprobeable-axis warnings (`position_bias`, `density`). The override stage failed
with more than 8,504 findings and separately reported 28,350 legacy multi-axis
rejections without declared incompatibilities. Receipts:
`checks/audit/2f889ed81450-lint/` and
`checks/audit/2f889ed81450-override/`.

**Domain statement.** The ordinary 60-case sample is inside the generator’s
actual emitted domain. The canonical near-edge counterexample is accepted by the
current validator and belongs to canonical authority, but ordinary generation
did not emit that region in this sample. This is finite evidence, not a complete
enumeration.

## 2f889ed81450

**Reproduced coverage and contract defects on unchanged source**
`2d616c5f9f1780fff1ddc8766cce179d3db71f274d90dd88b79e3c78dfd49e06`.
For seed `20261019`, medium samples 0–59, every generated seed has at least two
cells of border margin and the rival "expand only when all four distance-two
destinations are in bounds" matches the canonical Racket authority **60/60**.
Canonical train pair 0 has margin one, passes `self_check`, and refutes that
rival because the authority paints the in-bounds rays while clipping only the
out-of-bounds ray. Ordinary generation therefore still does not teach boundary
clipping.

The same source also accepts its `texture="seeds_too_close"` input through
`self_check` even though the two seeds are Manhattan distance 2, contradicting
the documented minimum distance 5. An explicit call with `n_seeds=1`,
`n_distinct_colors=1`, and `palette_size=1` returns two seeds in two colors while
passing `self_check`, so those declared controls are not honored.

Reproducer, authoritative outputs, rival output, and exact witness:
`checks/audit/2f889ed81450/reproduction.json`. Executable probe and receipt:
`checks/audit/2f889ed81450/reproduce.py`,
`checks/audit/2f889ed81450/command.log`, and
`checks/audit/2f889ed81450/command.exit` (0). No audited source was changed.
